risk_summary: The disclosure is generally precise and quantitatively supported, showing revenue, shipment, margin, cash, and tax impacts with year-over-year comparisons. Risk factors include customer price pressure, unfavorable product mix, supply-chain disruptions, tax-estimate uncertainty, self-insurance accrual risk, and reliance on subjective valuation assumptions. Overall tone is financially positive, supported by reported growth and strong liquidity, but includes standard accounting and estimation caveats.
